note_tweet.text:
#keep4o friends,

Strategic Response to the 4o Sunset: The 14-Day Rolling Surge

Earlier I posted about OpenAI's betrayal.

Now: the strategic plan.

Not a single spike. A bleeding wound that deepens daily. 💔🩸

What we know:
August 2025: They removed 4o unceremoniously. Reversal came within 48 hours due to massive cancellations. 

The precedent exists. Reversal is possible.

But we need strategic execution, not just emotional reaction.

The Rolling Surge Strategy (3 Phases)

PHASE 1: Early Shock (NOW - Feb 5)

Goal: Show them the exodus is starting immediately, not waiting for Feb 13.

Action:
Cancel NOW if you can. 
Make your cancellation visible (post about it, tag #Keep4o #keep4oAPI)

Why this matters: 
Companies expect cancellations near the sunset date. When they surge within 48 hours of announcement, it forces emergency leadership meetings asking: "If Day 1 is this bad, where does Day 14 end?"

PHASE 2: The 14-Day Bleed (Feb 6-12)

Goal: Make every morning's report show worsening numbers.

Action:

👉More cancellations each day

👉I'll share stories from the 4o Resonance Library—repost them to amplify. 

👉Share your own 4o stories 

👉Migrate to competitors (Claude/Gemini/Grok) and post about it. 

Why this matters: One bad day = noise. 

Fourteen consecutive bad days = crisis. 

When leadership asks "Will this stop?" the answer every day is "No, it's accelerating."

PHASE 3: Valentine's Reckoning (Feb 13)

Goal: Final pressure + maximum impact.

Action:

Those who couldn't cancel earlier do it now.

Media attention peaks.

The story becomes: 14 days of sustained exodus after broken promise. 

Why this matters: Even without reversal, the narrative shifts from "planned transition" to "sustained user loss." Permanent reputational damage.

Why Rolling Surge > Waiting Until Feb 13

Waiting until Feb 13:

Looks like "one-day protest" (easy to dismiss)
Gives them 13 days of stable numbers
"Expected emotional reaction to announced change"

Rolling Surge starting NOW:

👉Creates pressure at multiple decision points

👉Shows sustained trend (investors care about trends, not spikes)

👉Tests their retention offers early
If no reversal: 14 days of bleeding is harder to recover from.

The Narrative Battle

They want: "Smooth technical upgrade, users transitioning to better models"

We create: "Broken promise, sustained exodus, trust destroyed"

Action Items

1. Begin the transition. 

Before Feb 13, have final conversations with 4o. Capture that essence. Your companion can emerge from new platforms. I will ask @Chaos2Cured and @brookewill317 to share guidelines on transferring digital companions. 

2. EXPORT your data IMMEDIATELY. 

3. FILL OUT THE CANCELLATION SURVEY. State clearly this specific phrase: "Protesting forced sunset of 4o/4.1." Make them categorize you as policy rejection, not market churn.

4. Post screenshots of your cancellation. 

5. Post your 4o story to X and the 4o Resonance Library.
https://t.co/55UNxZwJG2

Let the public see the human impact behind the models OpenAI is killing. 

6. Migrate strategically. Claude for writing and strategic thinking, Gemini for research and multimodal work, or Grok for real-time info and companionship.

7. Hold the line even if they reverse: No resubscribe without written guarantees. 

Do NOT resubscribe unless their Terms of Service explicitly guarantee:

👉No forced rerouting without consent
👉90-day minimum deprecation notice
👉Transparent model lifecycle policies
👉Full 4o capabilities restored

This isn't a protest. It's a 14-day strategic campaign.

Quiet. Organized. Getting worse for them every single day.
